app.name: OpenLight
app.tagline: Your lights follow the colors on your screen.

color_mode.title: Color mode
color_mode.help: Dominant: the color you see the most in the zone. Average: the mix of the whole zone.

saturation.title: Color boost
saturation.help: Multiplies saturation. Higher means more intense colors.

brightness_min.title: Minimum brightness
brightness_min.help: Light brightness when the screen is dark.

brightness_max.title: Maximum brightness
brightness_max.help: Brightness cap when the screen is very bright.

smoothing_ms.title: Smoothing
smoothing_ms.help: Higher means slower, flicker-free transitions. Scene cuts are always faster.

send_channel.title: Light channel
send_channel.help: How colors are sent to the light. If colors look choppy, try the control channel.

capture_fps.title: Captures per second
capture_fps.help: How many times per second the screen is read. Higher is faster but uses more power.

max_sends_per_s.title: Commands per second
max_sends_per_s.help: Maximum colors sent to the light per second. Lower it if the light stutters.

send_threshold.title: Send threshold
send_threshold.help: Changes smaller than this are not sent, since you can't see them.

black_bar.title: Black bars
black_bar.help: Rows and columns darker than this count as black bars and don't affect brightness.

grey_threshold.title: Grey threshold
grey_threshold.help: Below this saturation the screen counts as grey and the light turns white.

dark_screen.title: Dark screen
dark_screen.help: Below this brightness the last color is kept instead of turning white.

hue_stickiness.title: Hue stability
hue_stickiness.help: Keeps the light from jumping between two colors that cover almost the same area.

no_screen_wait_s.title: Wait without screen
no_screen_wait_s.help: With no screen for this long, the light goes back to how it was until the screen returns.

heartbeat_s.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat_s.help: How often the light is told the connection is still alive.

dead_after_s.title: Connection dead after
dead_after_s.help: With no reply from the light for this long, it reconnects.

screen_permission_denied.title: Screen Recording permission missing
screen_permission_denied.detail: Without it the screen can't be read. Turn it on in Settings and reopen OpenLight.

local_network_denied.title: Local Network permission missing
local_network_denied.detail: Without it the lights can't be reached. Turn it on in System Settings.

firewall_blocked.title: The firewall blocks light discovery
firewall_blocked.detail: Allow OpenLight in the firewall to find the lights on your network.

capture_unsupported.title: Screen capture isn't available
capture_unsupported.detail: Your desktop doesn't offer a way to share the screen (ScreenCast portal).

no_display.title: No display
no_display.detail: No screen is on right now. OpenLight will resume when one shows up.

device_not_found.title: Can't find the light
device_not_found.detail: Make sure it's on and the computer is on the same Wi-Fi.

device_key_rejected.title: The light rejected the key
device_key_rejected.detail: The local key changed (error 914). Renew it with one click.

device_timeout.title: The light isn't responding
device_timeout.detail: It may be switched off at the wall or too far from the router.

device_busy.title: Another app is using the light
device_busy.detail: Close the Smart Life app on your phone: it sometimes holds the light's local connection.

device_no_colour.title: This device can't show colors
device_no_colour.detail: It only has white light, so it can't follow the screen.

cloud_invalid_signature.title: The Access Secret doesn't match
cloud_invalid_signature.detail: It was probably copied wrong. Copy it again from iot.tuya.com.

cloud_invalid_token.title: The Tuya session expired
cloud_invalid_token.detail: Try again; if it persists, check the Access ID.

cloud_permission_denied.title: Tuya denied access
cloud_permission_denied.detail: Check that you linked your Smart Life account to the project and picked the right Data Center.

cloud_wrong_region.title: Wrong Data Center
cloud_wrong_region.detail: Your credentials work in {region}. Switch to it?

cloud_service_not_authorized.title: A service is missing from the project
cloud_service_not_authorized.detail: Add the IoT Core service to your Cloud project.

cloud_trial_expired.title: The IoT Core trial expired
cloud_trial_expired.detail: You can extend it for free at iot.tuya.com. It's only needed to renew keys.

invalid_setting.title: Invalid value
invalid_setting.detail: The {setting} setting doesn't accept that value.

storage.title: Couldn't save the settings
storage.detail: Check that there's free disk space.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.detail: Export the diagnostics and open an issue so we can look into it.
